kitDescription: Nero is a Fire SMG Defender with a Burst II who plays as a heal-reactive tank. Whenever an ally heals her, the healer gets a short Damage Taken reduction and Nero builds a stacking self-buff called Cat's Repayment (up to 5 stacks, each lasting 5 seconds). When she is attacked, she has a 30% chance to make the attacker take increased damage, and while in her Grumpy Cat status that same proc also fires a 158.05% counter-hit. Her burst deals a single large hit (1104.91% of final ATK) to the highest-HP enemy, taunts all enemies for 15 seconds, and — if Cat's Repayment is at max stacks when she casts — grants her Grumpy Cat, boosting her incoming healing for 15 seconds. She also passively starts each battle with 60.28% more Max HP. In the scope-lock DPS sim, where the boss never attacks and heals carry no HP amounts, only her burst nuke and her Max HP passive have any observable effect.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHAs. The driver's two modeled lines are faithful and provably firing: the 1104.91% burst nuke is own-burstCast-keyed, lands pre-FB (fbMajorApplied false pinned), fires once per cast at ≥5 casts per fight, and discriminates against the lvl-1 magnitude, removal, and FB-boosted nearest-wrongs; the Max HP ▲60.28% passive uses targetMaxHpPct — the schema carrier that actually materializes an observable maxHpFlat self-grant — pinned at the exact 0.6028×static-HP value against an independent block-removed basis, frame 0, permanent, self-scoped, and byte-inert under removal. The six Grumpy-Cat-chain lines are unanimous DOCUMENTED_GAPs carried verbatim with an activation recipe: the S2b reviewer's FIX divergence on the stack/status chain is adjudicated in the driver's favor because both blind post-op agents (S5's gap list, S6's override) independently re-derived the identical ruling from prose alone, and the chain's only damage-side observables require an 'attacked' trigger, a chance primitive, a stack-count gate, and heal amounts that v1 does not have — modeling any of it would fabricate kit-silent semantics or degenerate into S2b's own named nearest-wrong unconditional grant. The S5 run's 7 reds are all blind-side artifacts (2 fixture starvation behind crown — a phenomenon S2b itself pre-warned about — 4 override-shape TypeErrors, 1 event-payload guess); zero allege the shipped encoding does anything the kit does not say, and S5's negative guards that did run (no leaked damageTakenPct, no 158.05% rider, no 60.08 leak) all passed against the driver. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: the universal convergence on the unmodeled ruling rests on the shared premise that the scope-lock boss deals no damage and heals carry no amounts — if that engine premise ever changes, the 8.26% boss Damage Taken ▲ line (all agents' named largest unmodeled offensive loss, worth roughly a team-wide ×1.08 at realistic uptime) is the first thing to re-open, with the driver's recorded ⚑ cadence recipe (boss attack rate × 30%, taunt-amplified) as the measurement entry point.
